body:
Root cause of the 3-day red release pipeline: hand-copied Windows dw_gui.exe gcc line missing DEADWEIGHT core/runtime/parena_runtime.c (arena_alloc). Reproduced the whole Windows apps step locally, fixed (5f00357), v0.136.0 published with all 5 bundled apps. Ended the 9x drift class by deriving CI source lists from the Makefile (6e709ab). Pause menu gained BULLET HOLES/FULLSCREEN toggles (bed4371). Memory + BACKLOG S588 record the features-need-menu-items rule.

⚓ ☃
title: SHANKPIT release pipeline recovered: v0.136.0 published; CI source lists now derived from Makefile
